title: Love these!!
text: Love these!!. These are wonderful nesting baskets. They are made well and have a metal bar Across the bottom for extra strength. They fit together perfectly. Have a wonderful little knobby handle That you can close The top of the basket with the little cord that is attached. Each basket has a little chalkboard square on the front so you can label what is inside. It also comes with 3 pc of chalk. They have wonderful roomie open handles on the side To lift and carry. They are a nice natural tan coloring.

product_metadata.title: Set of 2 Decorative Rope Baskets for Organizing - Boho Style Storage Bins with Handles for Bathroom, Living Room and More - Perfect for Storing Tissues, Towels, and Other Accessories
features: Boho Baskets for Easy Organization: Simplify your space with these beautiful baskets! Whether you need to organize your bathroom, kitchen, pantry, or any other area, these baskets make it a breeze.
Bathroom Storage Made Stylish: Keep your towels and toiletries within reach while adding a touch of style to your bathroom. These baskets are the perfect size for even the smallest of spaces.
Convenient Size and Material: Versatile and practical, these baskets are the ideal size for storing everything from toiletries and towels to fruit, books, toys, and baking supplies.

Multiple Uses for Any Room: The braided rope design and natural colors of these baskets lend a boho vibe to any space. Use them to store craft supplies, promotional materials, party decor, toys, books, and so much more. The possibilities are endless!

Quality and Customer Support: We stand behind our product and our customers. You can trust that we will always treat you with fairness and respect. Our industry-leading policies and customer service will not disappoint you.
